text: Ado ɓee ɗoo, hari yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen fenniino Nulaaɓe mun, feddeeji ɗin ɓaawo maɓɓe kadi fenni Aadi, e Samuuda, e yimɓe Luutu ɓen, e wonndiiɓe Madyana ɓen e Fir'awna'en fow. Mofte kala e ɓen ɗon, himmiri nanngugol Nulaaɗo mun on, fii warugol mo. Ɓe wennjiri meere maɓɓe, fii bonnitirgol nde goonga kan. Kono Mi nanngi ɓe. Tesko no nanngal Am waɗtinirnoo e maɓɓe. Ɗum ko lepte saɗtuɗe wonunoo.
